description: Future Energy Scenarios (FES) is the annual set of net zero pathways for Great Britain's whole energy system, published by the National Energy System Operator; the 2025 edition, titled Pathways to Net Zero, is the fifteenth and the first since NESO was established in October 2024. The page offers the main report, an executive summary, a data workbook with all graphs and supporting data, an interactive dashboard, an economics annex, a regional breakdown of the FES 2025 data and an archive of earlier editions, plus a 2026 Ten Year Outlook. Pathways explore energy demand and supply across the whole system, including heat and transport, to 2050. Access: PDF documents, an Excel data workbook and a dashboard, all downloadable without registration; NESO also lets signed-in users manage dataset subscriptions. Licence and cost: free; the page states no licence. Caveats: scenarios are policy pathways built with stakeholders, not forecasts, and the regional breakdown is a derived product. It suits long-term capacity planning and scenario inputs for grid and hydrogen studies, and complements the NESO data portal and the ENTSO-E and ENTSOG TYNDP scenarios catalogued here.
